What's the Coruscant Guard doing here?|"Hunter"|}} '''Imperial shock troopers''', formerly '''clone guards''' under the [[Galactic Republic]], were elite [[stormtrooper]]s who served in the [[Coruscant Guard]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[shock trooper]]s were specialized [[clone trooper]]s who served as a [[Law enforcement agency|security police force]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], [[capital]] of the Republic. Noted for their distinctive [[Color|red]] and white [[clone trooper armor]], they supplemented the [[Senate Guard]] as [[bodyguard]]s for [[Galaxy|galactic]] [[senator]]s, [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and other officials, such as [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. In addition to protecting the [[Imperial Executive Building|government facilities]] and officials of the [[Galactic Senate]], shock [[trooper]]s specialized in guarding [[prison]]s, maintaining civil order as [[Riot clone trooper|anti-riot police officers]], and [[Diplomatic service|escorting]] [[diplomat]]s for off-world assignments. The '''Coruscant shock troopers''' served under [[Clone Commander]] [[Fox]], the [[commanding officer]] of the Coruscant Guard, during the [[the galaxy]]-wide Clone War between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Other [[clone trooper officer]]s who commanded shock troopers included [[Clone Lieutenant]] [[Thire]], Clone [[Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)|Stone]], and Clone Commander [[Thorn]]. Shock troopers participated in a number of events both on Coruscant and elsewhere during the war, from the [[Raid on Ziro's Palace|raid]] on [[Ziro's Palace]], the [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano|hunt]] for [[Ahsoka Tano]], and the [[Mission to Level 1325|hunt]] for rogue clone trooper [[Fives]], to the [[Battle of Rugosa|ambush]] on [[Rugosa]], the [[Mission to Florrum|mission]] to [[Florrum]], and the [[Invasion of Scipio|invasion]] of [[Scipio]]. The capital's security was breached on two occasions despite the presence of the clone shock [[troop]]s; Coruscant's [[central power distribution grid]] was [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid|bombed]] by [[Infiltrator demolition droid|Separatist infiltration droids]], and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] was released from Republic custody as a result of the [[Senate hostage crisis]] in which a group of politicians were held captive by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]]. As the war continued '''clone shock troopers''' were stationed in the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Republic Center for Military Operations]], which included a detention area for suspected [[terrorist]]s and [[Treason|traitors to the state]]. Shock troopers were also tasked with maintaining order in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]], a facility for [[prisoner]]s such as Bane, [[Moralo Eval]], [[Aurra Sing]], and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]. Though Bane and Eval [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center|escaped]] from the Republic [[prison]], they were [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine|recaptured]] on [[Naboo]] by the shock troopers who escorted Chancellor Palpatine to the [[Festival of Light (847th)|847th]] [[Festival of Light]]. A contingent of shock troopers deployed to the [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army's]] [[homeworld]] of [[Kamino]] in the aftermath of [[Order 66]]. With the [[Battle of Utapau|end]] of the Clone Wars and Palpatine's [[Proclamation of the New Order|ascension]] as [[Galactic Emperor]], '''Imperial clone shock troopers''' became the [[Special forces|elite forces]] of the [[New Order|new]] [[Galactic Empire]]. Though they retained their [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] during the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Imperial Era]], in [[time]] the shock troopers upgraded to a customized version of [[stormtrooper armor]]. By then, the Empire had chosen to supplant [[Cloning|clones]] with [[Reproduction|birth-born]] [[human]] [[soldier]]s. ==History== ===Clone Wars=== ====Guardians of the Republic==== {{Quote|I hope the general reaches the rendezvous point.''"
"''We're sure buying him time.|Clone shock troopers Rys and Jek|{{TCW|Ambush}}}} [[File:Ziro_captured.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Senator Padmé Amidala was rescued by clone shock troopers during the raid on Ziro's Palace.]] [[Cloning|Clone]] shock [[trooper]]s originated as [[Law enforcement agency|security police]] for the administrative facilities on [[Coruscant]], as well as [[bodyguard]]s for government officials during the [[Clone Wars]]. Even though they were bred on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]],''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' they were secretly raised on Coruscant, the [[capital]] [[planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic]],''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' during the last [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Republic Era]], whereas the rest of the [[clone trooper]]s were trained{{Film|II}} far away on Kamino. Both groups were cloned from the same [[DNA|genetic]] [[Clone template|source]], the [[human]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]]. With the [[Military Creation Act|introduction]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] followed by the [[First Battle of Geonosis|first battle]] of the Clone Wars, the clone shock troopers were organized as the [[Coruscant Guard]] under [[Clone Commander]] [[Fox]].''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' During the early [[Standard day|days]] of the war, [[Ziro's Palace]] was [[Raid on Ziro's Palace|raided]] by a contingent of shock troopers led by Fox. The clones charged into the establishment, destroying the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]]'s [[B1-series battle droid]]s and [[IG-86 sentinel droid]]s in order to rescue [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] tried to escape, but was cornered by the shock troopers and arrested on the senator's order. Ziro's subsequent confession to the [[Battle of Teth|abduction]] of his nephew [[Rotta]], son of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], resulted in a formal [[Hutt–Republic treaty|treaty]] between the [[Hutt Clan]] and the [[Galaxy|Galactic]] Republic. [[File:Jek_Rys_and_Thire_cave.png|thumb|right|250px|A trio of clone shock troopers served under Jedi General Yoda during a diplomatic mission to Rugosa.]] Though assigned to Coruscant, shock troopers were deployed throughout [[the galaxy]] as needed. A detachment of the Coruscant Guard—[[diplomatic service]] shock troopers "[[Jek]]," "[[Rys]]," and [[Clone Lieutenant]] [[Thire]]—escorted [[Jedi General]] [[Yoda]] to [[Rugosa]] where he sought an audience with the [[Toydarian]] [[king]] [[Katuunko]] during the early days of the Clone Wars. To prevent an alliance between [[Toydaria]] and the Republic, [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]] dispatched [[Asajj Ventress]] with an [[Ventress's army|army]] to [[Battle of Rugosa|ambush and destroy]] the Republic envoy. The shock troopers fought back, destroying several [[battle droid]]s before retreating on Yoda's orders due to the sheer number of [[droid]]s. The clones had nearly exhausted their supply of ammunition in the firefight, and the [[lieutenant]] was injured. Yoda confronted the remaining enemy [[battalion]] alone, instructing his bodyguards to stand by and wait for the right moment to assist him. The opportunity came when a group of [[droideka]]s tried to ambush Yoda; armed with the [[squad]]'s last [[missile]], Thire created a rockslide that crushed the destroyer droids. After saving Katuunko from Ventress, the shock troopers and their [[general]] boarded a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]], having succeeded in their mission to secure Toydaria's support for the Republic. In [[21 BBY]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|30|Highlights of the Saga}} but still early in the war, a [[captain]] of the [[Senate Guard]], a [[Senate Commando]] named [[Faro Argyus]], revealed he had betrayed the Republic and helped [[Rescue on the Tranquility|rescue]] the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation]], [[Nute Gunray]]. Though he was murdered by Ventress out of annoyance,{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}} his betrayal weakened the authority of the Senate Guard, as the loyalty of the organization was called into question. Clone shock troopers grew to replace the Senate Guard, representing the growing executive power of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. [[File:Clones_jar_jar.png|thumb|left|250px|Clone shock troopers accompanied Junior Representative Jar Jar Binks to Florrum.]] Clone [[Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)|Stone]] and other members of the Coruscant Guard were tasked with protecting Senator [[Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] during their [[Mission to Florrum|mission]] to [[Florrum]]. However, the senator was killed as a result of an attack on their [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class transport]] by rogue members of the [[Ohnaka Gang]]. Although Stone was a [[clone trooper officer]], Binks' status as a government official gave him authority over the clone shock troopers who were, therefore, obliged to follow the [[Gungan]] [[Politics|politician's]] orders. The group was forced to contend with [[Weequay]] [[pirate]]s as they made their way to the [[Hondo's complex|base]] of Captain [[Hondo Ohnaka]], attempting to deliver a payment in [[spice]] for the ransom of [[Count]] Dooku. While they did not succeed in taking custody of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Head of State]], Binks and the shock troopers managed to rescue [[Jedi]] Generals [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], both of whom had been taken captive by the pirates. [[File:Boba_Confronts_Mace_Windu.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Boba Fett was incarcerated in a prison guarded by clone shock troopers for trying to kill Jedi General Mace Windu.]] [[Boba Fett]], an unmodified clone and son of the Grand [[Army]] of the Republic's clone template, Jango Fett, was [[Second mission to Florrum|arrested]] after [[Sabotage of the Endurance|attempting]] to assassinate Jedi General [[Mace Windu]]. The young clone was taken to the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]], a Coruscant [[prison]] guarded by clone shock troopers. Following a brief confrontation between Windu and Fett, the shock troops escorted the [[prisoner]] into the facility on the general's orders.{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}} ====Sentries across the capital==== {{Quote|Mission accomplished, sir. The chancellor is safe.''"
"''Well done, trooper.|A clone shock trooper and Orn Free Taa|{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}}} [[File:Shocktrooperpatrol.png|thumb|left|250px|Shock trooper patrols combed the streets of Coruscant to find Duchess Satine Kryze.]] During the [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze|plot]] to kill [[Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze]] of [[Mandalore]], the Coruscant Guard patrolled the streets of the capital, stopping civilians to question them on the whereabouts of the [[Mandalorian]] [[noble]]woman. Framed for the [[death]] of [[Davu Golec]], Kryze hid from the clone shock troopers as well as the [[police droid]]s and [[police probe]]s scouring the [[city]] to find her. Two shock troopers, armed as [[Riot clone trooper|clone riot troopers]], were in the process of interrogating an [[Ithorian]] despite the [[alien]]'s failure to communicate in [[Galactic Basic Standard]]. The same troopers almost captured Kryze, but the duchess managed to elude them by running through a crowded street. The clones who pursued her reported that Kryze was traveling in a [[speeder]] to [[Section IG-44]], unaware that she had deceived them.{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}} [[Aurra Sing]] was brought to Coruscant following her attempt on the life of Senator Amidala at the [[Alderaan Refugee Conference|refugee conference]] on [[Alderaan]]. The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] that brought Sing to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] were supplemented by clone shock troopers while guarding the captured [[assassin]]. Shortly afterward, General Skywalker and his [[Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], traveled to the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center where Ziro was incarcerated under the watchful guard of the clone shock troopers. Using a [[repulsorcraft]] [[pilot]]ed by a shock trooper, the Jedi duo confronted the Hutt prisoner in his cell where they tricked him into confessing his involvement in the plot to kill the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo people's]] representative. [[File:Ziro_released.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Senate hostage crisis forced the clone shock troopers to release Ziro Desilijic Tiure from prison.]] A [[Senate hostage crisis|crisis]] occurred on Coruscant when members of the [[Galactic Senate]] were held hostage by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] and his hired [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. Quickly dispatching any Senate Commandos in their path and using the captive politicians as leverage, Bane pressured Chancellor Palpatine to release Ziro Desilijic Tiure from prison. The Coruscant Guard attempted to outmaneuver Bane, initially complying with his demands while dispatching clone shock troopers to the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]]. One of the troopers contacted the Senator [[Orn Free Taa]] to confirm that they had secured the [[Emperor's office|chancellor's office]]. With the chancellor safe, Commander Fox and his men confronted Bane's group as they attempted to leave the Senate headquarters. However, the [[bounty]] hunter threatened to kill his hostages with [[bomb]]s planted within the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]]. The Clone Commander ordered his troops to stand down, the chancellor having agreed to allow the mercenaries to leave with Ziro in exchange for the hostages. Because Senate Commandos had failed to stop Bane, the hostage crisis became an argument in favor of the open use of clone troopers on Coruscant as secruity forces.{{HelmetCollectionCite|30|Weapons & Uniforms}} While the Coruscant Guard had already begun to be openly deployed on the capital at that point anyway, the hostage crisis, like Argyus's betrayal, hurt trust in the Blue Guard. As such, it helped usher in the new, clone-dominated era. One example of the change on Coruscant was as follows: for the first year or so of the Clone Wars, Senate Commandos had been used as additional secruity and as a quickly-deployed military force to meet the new secruity requirements faced by Coruscant. However, clone troopers came to replace the Senate Commandos in those roles. Clone shock troopers continued to serve as guards in the Detention Center on Coruscant while the Clone Wars continued; one of their prisoners was [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]], a [[Geonosian]] leader whom the Republic captured during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis|second invasion]] of [[Geonosis]]. Two clone guards escorted an [[officer]] of the [[Republic Corps of Engineers]], [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]], to Poggle's cell where the surveillance system was taken offline for the duration of Krennic's visit. The troopers also deactivated the [[ray shield]] as Krennic wished to speak directly with Poggle regarding his involvement in the development of a [[Death Star|secret battle station]].''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' [[File:CitadelDebrief-CR.png|thumb|left|250px|The survivors who escaped from Lola Sayu were greeted by members of the Jedi High Council and the Coruscant Guard.]] Several shock troopers were present at the [[Jedi temple|Temple]] where members of the [[Jedi High Council]] welcomed the survivors from the [[Battle of Lola Sayu]] upon their return to Coruscant. One of the survivors, Captain [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], was escorted by two clone guards as he departed from the Temple on a [[Util-313]] repulsorcraft, taking his half of the coordinates to the [[Nexus Route]] directly to Chancellor Palpatine.{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} Senator Amidala's [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative|peace initiative]] prompted Dooku to send an infiltration team to Coruscant. Disguised as sweeper units, several [[infiltrator demolition droid]]s approached the checkpoint to a restricted area guarded by clone shock troopers. Commander Fox allowed the droids to pass, unaware of their true programming, and even pointed them in the correct direction of Coruscant's [[central power distribution grid]]. The [[demolition droid]]s [[Bomb|self-detonated]] upon reaching their destination, causing a widespread blackout across [[Imperial City|Galactic City's]] [[Federal District|Senate District]] which, in turn, undermined the peace process, allowing more of their brothers to join the fight against the Separatists.{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} ====Rako Hardeen plot==== {{Quote|Turn your weapons off stun. Kill the prisoners if you have to.|A clone shock trooper|{{TCW|Deception}}}} [[File:PrisonRiot-Deception.png|thumb|right|250px|A riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center was contained by clone shock troopers.]] Following the staged demise of Kenobi, his "killer," [[Rako Hardeen]], was arrested by Skywalker and Tano, who turned him over to the custody of the Coruscant Guard. Unknown to all except High [[Jedi Council|Council]] of the [[Jedi Order]], the prisoner that the clone shock troopers escorted into the Detention Center was Kenobi disguised as Hardeen. While Kenobi was undercover, attempting to gather information on a plot to abduct the Supreme Chancellor, Cad Bane and [[Moralo Eval]] instigated a [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center|prison riot]] in order to escape from the Detention Center. Clone shock troopers tried to contain the riot using non-lethal weapons such as [[electrostaff]]s and the [[stun]] setting on their [[blaster rifle]]s. As the riot spread from the cafeteria to the prison's corridors, the shock troopers were given authorization to use deadly force against the inmates. Though the shock troops eventually restored order, Bane and Eval escaped with Kenobi whom they believed to be Hardeen. [[File:VictoryOnNaboo-Crisis.png|thumb|left|250px|Cad Bane and Moralo Eval were arrested by clone shock troopers for abducting the Supreme Chancellor on Naboo.]] With Chancellor Palpatine adamant on attending the [[Festival of Light (847th)|847th anniversary]] of the [[Festival of Light]], General Windu gathered a security force comprising both Senate Guards and clone shock troopers. The shock troopers stayed in close proximity to the Supreme Chancellor as well as his entourage, including Skywalker, Amidala, and [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]]. During the festival in [[Theed]], however, the Chancellor was captured by Bane and Eval. Kenobi, still disguised as Hardeen, prevented them from leaving Naboo with Palpatine as their hostage, giving the Jedi time to intercept the mercenaries and rescue the Chancellor. Eval surrendered and was arrested alongside Bane by the shock troopers. One of the clones restrained Bane as he shouted threats at Kenobi upon discovering his true identity. Believing the [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine|incident]] was over, the Jedi allowed the security force to leave Naboo at the insistence of Palpatine, who assured them that Skywalker was sufficient for his protection. ====Reaching the end==== {{Quote|We're taking you in now, Commander.''"
"''That's ''not'' going to happen, trust me. Now, I'm not going to hurt any of you… ''We're'' not going to hurt any of you, but you're ''not'' taking me in.''"
"''Commander, we ''are'' taking you in.|Wolffe and Ahsoka Tano, Tano resisting arrest from shock troopers|audio=WeAreTakingYouIn-TCaJ.flac|{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}}} The [[bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar]] precipitated a civilian protest against the Clone Wars. Clone shock troopers, armed with riot control gear, were stationed as sentries at the end of the Temple's [[Processional Way]] where they blocked the protesters from advancing on the main entrance to the Temple. The [[Jedi Temple Guard]], under the command of [[Jedi Master]] [[Cin Drallig]], supplemented the shock troops during the demonstration.{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}} [[File:AhsokaEscape.png|thumb|right|250px|Clone shock troopers tried to capture Ahsoka Tano after she was framed for the killing of Letta Turmond.]] Tano was detained by clone shock troopers in the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Republic Center for Military Operations]]; she had been framed for the killing of [[Letta Turmond]], a prisoner involved in the [[terrorist]] attack on the Temple, and was arrested by Commander Fox on the suspicion of murder. Skywalker demanded access to his Padawan, but the shock troopers stood their ground, refusing to allow him entry into the facility's prison area as ordered by [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. Tano attempted to [[escape from the Republic military base]] after she was framed for assaulting and killing several shock troopers. A manhunt ensued with shock trooper patrols deploying throughout the facility to capture the Jedi apprentice. Dodging and deflecting a barrage of stun bolts, Tano evaded Fox's shock troopers and fled to the [[Coruscant Underworld|lower levels]] of Coruscant. [[File:Video_store.png|thumb|left|250px|A group of clone shock troopers encounter Asajj Ventress while hunting Ahsoka Tano in the Coruscant underworld.]] Both the Coruscant Guard and the [[Coruscant Security Force]] searched for Tano in the undercity; she was found with Asajj Ventress on [[Level 1315]] by a detachment of clone shock troopers led by Clone Commander [[Wolffe]] of the [[104th Battalion]]. Despite holding a numerical advantage, the clones were disarmed of their [[blaster]]s and overpowered by the two [[Force-sensitive]]s. Wolffe and his shock troops resumed their search for Tano whom they found in a warehouse filled with incriminating evidence connected to the attack on the Jedi Temple. Using a stun bolt to incapacitate her, the shock troopers [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano|recaptured Tano]] and [[transport]]ed her back to the Republic base. Clone shock troopers escorted Tano to her [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano|trial]], presided by Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine at the Republic Center for Military Operations. Before the trial concluded, Anakin Skywalker entered the court room with the Jedi Temple Guards and [[Barriss Offee]], who confessed to the crimes that Tano had been accused of committing. Offee was then escorted out of the chamber by clone shock troopers as well as the Temple Guards.{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}} [[File:CoruscantGuardssearching.png|thumb|right|250px|Accused of attacking the Supreme Chancellor, Fives was hunted by clone shock troopers of the Coruscant Guard.]] [[Fives]], an [[Advanced Recon Commando]] of the [[501st Legion]], was taken to the [[Grand Republic Medical Facility]] on Coruscant as part of an investigation concerning the [[behavioral modification biochip]]s implanted within all clone troopers. Clone shock troopers were stationed in the facility upon Fives' arrival, supplementing the [[Emperor's Royal Guard|Red Guards]] of Chancellor Palpatine's security force. A scuffle ensued between Fives and the Chancellor's guards, and Palpatine accused the ARC trooper of attacking him. Fives [[Escape from the Grand Republic Medical Facility|fled from the facility]], having learned that his fellow clones were programmed to betray and kill their Jedi [[officer]]s. The Coruscant Guard deployed shock troops to hunt the fugitive clone. One of the locations they searched was [[79's]], a [[cantina]] frequented by off-duty clones. Their arrival caused Fives to leave, though not before he was identified by an [[observation droid]]. Tracking the renegade to [[Hangar 18]] on [[Level 1325]], Commander Fox and his troops [[Mission to Level 1325|confronted Fives]] and ordered him to surrender. Fives raised a [[blaster pistol]] at Fox who shot first, resulting in the ARC trooper's demise before he could prove his claim about a plot against the Jedi.{{TCW|Orders (episode)}} [[File:DiplomaticCorps-CotH.png|thumb|left|250px|Senator Amidala's clone shock troopers were killed by Separatist battle droids during the invasion of Scipio.]] Senator Amidala brought an escort of clone shock troopers, under the leadership of Clone Commander "[[Thorn]]," to the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[Main Vault fortress|headquarters]] on [[Scipio]]. While Amidala was permitted to enter the [[city]], her guards and their counterparts, [[Separatist Congress Leader]] [[Bec Lawise]]'s [[BX-series droid commando]]s, were required to remain at their respective landing platforms due to the city's neutral status. Thorn and his men complied, but also assured Amidala that they were ready to assist the senator when needed. However, the [[Confederacy military]] launched an [[invasion of Scipio]] which began with a preemptive strike against Thorn's [[garrison]]. Separatist [[starfighter]]s destroyed the Coruscant Guard's [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)|''Consular''-class Armed Cruiser]] as well as their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[gunship]]s, while [[HMP droid gunship]]s deployed battle droids to kill the remaining shock troopers. Unable to retreat into the city Thorn and his men made a final stand. The commander continued to fight after the last of his troops fell in battle,{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} fighting valiantly until the droids killed him.{{Databank|clone-commander-thorn|Clone Commander Thorn}} ====Order 66==== {{Quote|Sir, are you all right?''"
"''Fine, just tired is all. I want you to go to the detention level. Execute Maul.''"
"''Yes, sir.|A clone shock trooper and Rex|}} [[File:CloneShockTroopers-Shattered.png|thumb|right|250px|Clone shock troopers attempted to execute Maul during Order 66, but the former Sith Lord was saved by Ahsoka Tano.]] Following the [[Siege of Mandalore|Republic victory]] on [[Mandalore]], the Coruscant Guard dispatched an escort of clone shock troopers to assist the [[332nd Division]] as they transported the former [[Sith]] [[Maul]] to Coruscant. Along the way, however, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth]] Sidious—the secret identity of Sheev Palpatine—issued [[Order 66]] to the clone troopers, all of whom were programmed to obey this directive without hesitation. As the members of the 332nd spread throughout the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'' [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|hunting]] their former ally, Ahsoka Tano, Clone Commander [[Rex]] instructed the shock troopers to execute Maul. Reaching Maul's cell in time, Tano disarmed and incapacitated the shock troops before they could carry out Rex's orders. Meanwhile, Commander Fox and his clone shock troopers targeted the Jedi on Coruscant,[[Darth Vader (2017) 9|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 9]] where the Jedi Temple was [[Operation: Knightfall|besieged]] by the 501st Legion, by then under the command of the newly christened [[Sith]] [[Lord]] Darth Vader. Like all clones, Fox and his troops complied with Order 66, believing it was their duty to suppress the Jedi whom they now regarded as "agitators." The shock troopers focused on containing the Jedi Temple and eliminating any Jedi that remained around Coruscant. Notably they lead efforts to eliminate [[Kelleran Beq|Jedi Master Kelleran Beq]] who escaped the Jedi Temple along with [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. They were stopped by a group of [[Royal Naboo Security Forces|Royal Naboo Security Officers]]. Beq was able to escape with Grogu on a [[H-type Nubian yacht|Naboo yacht]] despite the shock troopers' efforts.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 20: The Foundling}} {{Flash}} During Knightfall, 2 of them guarded Bariss Offee's cell and one of them told Bariss she should be glad she wasn't a Jedi anymore because of her bombing of the Temple and bragged to the [[Milarian]] that the Jedi won't exist anymore. The same 2 later accompanied the [[Inquisitor]] [[Fourth Sister]] to recruit her into the [[Inquisitorius]] and raised their blasters when Lyn warned Bariss the consequences of refusing her offer, though they didn't fire a single shot when Bariss accepted.{{TOTE|Devoted}} ====End of the Clone Wars==== {{Quote|The end of the war.''"
"''Say again, Trooper.''"
"''General Grievous was defeated on Utapau. The Separatist leadership has collapsed. The war is over.|A clone shock trooper and "Hunter"|}} [[File:Coruscant_Guards_on_Kamino.png|thumb|left|250px|A contingent of the Coruscant Guard was sent to Kamino in the aftermath of the Clone Wars.]] By the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]], a contingent of the Coruscant Guard was deployed to [[Tipoca City]] which was was under lockdown by this time, with shock troopers patrolling the landing platforms and the various corridors. [[Sergeant]] "[[Hunter]]," a genetically enhanced [[clone commando]] who served as the [[commanding officer]] of [[Clone Force 99]] "the Bad Batch," was surprised to see shock troopers on Kamino. Having returned in the aftermath of their [[Battle of Kaller|mission]] on [[Kaller]], neither Hunter nor his [[squad]] were aware of recent developments until a [[Unidentified shock trooper quartermaster|shock trooper quartermaster]] informed them the [[Battle of Utapau]] resulted in the death of General [[Grievous]], along with Skywalker’s killing of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist leadership]] on [[Mustafar]] and ending the Clone Wars. [[File:Coruscant-shock-troopers.png|thumb|right|250px|A quartermaster reported the end of the Clone Wars to the members of Clone Force 99.]] While speaking with the quartermaster, the members of Clone Force 99 noticed two clone troopers carrying the dead body of a Jedi on a stretcher. The quartermaster informed the [[commando]]s of a mandatory general assembly scheduled at fifteen hundred [[Standard hour|hours]], giving the Bad Batch enough time to retire to their [[barracks]] before the Supreme Chancellor's address on the [[Proclamation of the New Order|state of the Republic]]. The clone shock troopers were stationed in the staging area of Tipoca City where they witnessed Chancellor Palpatine's speech that he gave on Coruscant and broadcasted to Kamino. In addition to the Coruscant Guard troops who stood behind an assembly of clone troopers, there were shock troopers positioned near several [[Ruling Council (Kamino)|Kaminoan government]] officials who also attended the briefing, including [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]], his [[aide]] [[Taun We]], and [[Doctor]] [[Nala Se]]. With the [[Great Jedi Purge|extermination]] of most Jedi across [[the galaxy]], the [[New Order]] rose to power replacing the Republic as the [[Galactic Empire]]. The Grand Army of the Republic was reorganized as the [[Imperial Army]], the clone troopers were rechristened as [[stormtrooper]]s,{{Databank|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}} and the Coruscant Guard's elite clone units remained in service as Imperial clone shock troopers. ===The Empire's elite=== {{Quote|Shock troopers, closing in!|[[Gial Ackbar]]|''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]''}} [[File:Thiresenate.png|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial shock troopers failed to locate Yoda after his duel with Darth Sidious in the Senate Building on Coruscant.]] Following Yoda's [[Duel in the Galactic Senate|duel]] with Sidious, the self-styled [[Galactic Emperor]], the Coruscant Guard searched the Senate Building but failed to locate the [[Grand Master]], who evaded the clone guards before escaping into [[Exile (punishment)|exile]]. Their efforts shifted to helping the [[Emperor]] recover his injured [[Sith apprentice]] on [[Mustafar]], with Commander Thire assembling a [[Thire's squad|squad]] of the best Imperial shock troopers to accompany their [[lord]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|38|Helmets}} They returned to Coruscant using a [[medical capsule]] to bring Vader to the Grand Republic Medical Facility, which also hosted a security force of shock troopers by the time of the Emperor's arrival. [[File:Tarkin-arrives-on-Kamino.png|thumb|right|250px|A contingent of shock troopers from the Coruscant Guard was also dispatched to Kamino as a security detail for Admiral and Governor Wilhuff Tarkin.]] The contingent of the Coruscant Guard on Kamino was also there to escort Admiral and [[Governor]] Tarkin, where the [[Imperial officer]] intended to assess the needs of the Imperial Army and determine whether the Empire required the service of clone troopers. At Tarkin's direction, the shock troopers arrested the Bad Batch after he found their loyalty to the Empire wanting. The shock troopers delivered [[Crosshair]] to Tarkin and Nala Se for reprogramming, while the rest of Clone Force 99 was held in a prison cell in Tipoca City. Aided by a genetically modified clone, known as [[Omega]], the commandos incapacitated the clone guards and attempted to [[escape from Kamino]]. They were confronted by a squad of shock troopers led by Crosshair; despite their efforts, the Imperial clones failed to prevent their renegade brethren from escaping into the galaxy. During [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|Senator Amidala's funeral]], shock troopers provided security for the ceremony. When two troopers noticed Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] in a restricted area, they informed him of such, which he apologized for, citing the recent events for his confusion. However, unknown to the troopers, Organa had a private conversation with Tano and gave her an encoded transmitter to call him with a cryptic message that he needed her help to form the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after he saw that she attended Amidala's funeral to pay respects to their friend.{{TOTJ|Resolve (episode)}} [[File:ImperialCommanderFox-2017DarthVader9.png|thumb|left|250px|Fox posted shock troopers around the Jedi Temple, securing the area by the time of Darth Vader's arrival.]] During the early days of the [[Imperial Era]], shock troopers served as personal guards of Emperor Palpatine as well as his [[Emperor's Royal Guard|own]]. They were also put in charge of the [[Hunt for Jocasta Nu|hunt]] for Jedi Master [[Jocasta Nu]], the former [[Chief Librarian]] of the [[Jedi Archives]] and a high-value target of the Empire. Nu used [[the Force]] to [[Mind trick|influence]] the minds of Commander Fox and his men in order to gain entry into the fallen Jedi Temple.[[Darth Vader (2017) 7|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 7]] The Temple was locked down by the Coruscant Guard and [[Coruscant underworld police|supplemental units]] of the Coruscant Security Force by the time of Lord Vader's arrival. The Commander assured the [[Emperor's Fist|Emperor's Lieutenant]] that the area was secured by his [[soldier]]s, and that the fugitive Jedi would not escape from the Temple. However, Fox did not provide the other clones with Vader's description; as such, they opened fire on him, mistaking the Sith Lord for a Jedi during his pursuit of Nu. Vader took direct control of the shock troopers after executing Fox, and ultimately captured Nu with the aid of the Coruscant Guard. Several guardsmen were with Vader when he interrogated Nu, and discovered from the Jedi that they were, in fact, taking orders from another Jedi. The revelation of his former identity of Anakin Skywalker caused Vader to kill all of the shock troopers around him, an act which he blamed Nu for, although Nu was unconcerned as she felt that the clones had chosen their fate.[[Darth Vader (2017) 10|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 10]] In [[18 BBY]] more than a [[Standard year|year]] after the formation of the Empire, squads of shock troopers were in attendance for the voting on the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]] in the Imperial Senate Building and provided security for the occasion. After having been exposed for the [[Attack on Kamino|destruction of Kamino]] before the Senate, [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] was arrested by a squad of shock troopers on orders from Grand Vizier Mas Amedda before Emperor Palpatine condemned his actions.{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}} Later, a squad of recruited shock troopers was part of the security detail attached to Governor Tarkin, Commander [[Orson Callan Krennic]], [[General]] [[Hurst Romodi]], Admiral [[Barton Coburn]], and [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]] at the [[Imperial summit on Eriadu|summit]] at [[Raven's Peak]] on [[Eriadu]]. Several months later, the same squad of shock troopers accompanied Governor Tarkin and his fleet to Doctor Hemlock’s [[Tantiss Base|secret base]] to help deal with Clone Force 99’s [[Skirmish on Wayland|attack]] but arrived too late because the base was severely damaged by a [[Zillo Beast]] and Hemlock and several troopers of the [[Advanced Science Division]] were dead.{{TBB|The Summit}} [[File:ShockStormtroopers-2017DarthVader16.png|thumb|right|250px|Imperial shock troopers forced Orvek's neighborhood to leave their homes to destruction.]] During or before 18 BBY,According to ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'', the [[invasion of Mon Cala]] took place a [[Standard year|year]] into the [[Imperial Era]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the beginning of Imperial rule to [[19 BBY]], the invasion of Mon Cala took place in [[18 BBY]]. As the flashback featuring Imperial shock troopers is set during the Imperial Era but before the invasion, it must have occurred during or before that year. a team of shock troopers were dispatched to guard an Imperial effort to clear a city to make room for a new relay station. With the citizens objecting, one of the shock troopers repeated the explanation for what was happening before noting that the citizens would be compensated for what they dubbed an "inconvenience." When a man spoke up about how they had nowhere else to go, the shock troopers raised their [[DC-15A blaster carbine]]s against the crowd, ordering the citizens, among them a man named [[Orvek]], to leave.[[Darth Vader (2017) 16|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 16]] Ultimately, the Emperor ruled the galaxy for [[Standard decade|decades]], from the end of the Clone Wars to the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.{{Databank|galactic-empire|Galactic Empire}} Imperial shock troopers remained in service during this time period, acting as specialized units in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]]. Following the Emperor's demise at the [[Battle of Endor]], the shock troopers served in the [[Battle of Jakku]] where the [[New Republic]] defeated the Empire. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|I was here on Coruscant. Did my part—all the clones did. Shut those Jedi agitators down cold.|Fox|}} [[File:Clone_Shock_Trooper_05.png|thumb|left|250px|The shock troopers who once served the Galactic Republic became the elite enforcers of the Galactic Empire.]] The shock troopers' role in the initial [[Great Jedi Purge]] was remembered by their commanding officer, Fox shortly before his death. Commander Fox told Lord Vader that the shock troopers carried out their duty like all clone troopers by "coldly" executing Order 66 against the "Jedi agitators." After serving as a Coruscant police force during the Clone Wars, shock troopers became the elite forces of the Empire. Orvek's experience with the Empire and its shock troopers inspired a hate for the regime within him, with Padawan [[Ferren Barr]] playing on those emotions with a [[mind trick]] to turn him into one of his [[Ferren Barr's disciples|disciples]]. Like the Grand Army of the Republic and the Imperial Stormtrooper [[Corps]], the [[Alliance Military]] had specialized units who were trained for rapid deployment, and therefore classified as [[shock trooper]]s.''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' Colloquially referred to as "droppers,"{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 7: The Reckoning}} Rebel shock troopers such as [[Carasynthia Dune]] possessed skills that emphasized stealth and speed. During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance utilized [[dropship]]s to deploy the shock troopers into battle. They worked in teams and did not rely on the support of other Rebel units.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 4: Sanctuary}} The Alliance's successor, the [[New Republic]], inherited the shock troopers who helped to secure the [[Galactic Concordance|victory of the Rebellion]] over the Empire. However, without the Empire to fight, the shock troopers were repurposed to suppress riots, protect political dignitaries, and maintain peace in the [[New Republic Era]]. Dune therefore left the [[New Republic Defense Force]], retiring to the [[Outer Rim Territories]] where she later resumed her service to the [[New Republic Senate|nascent government]] as a [[Marshal]].{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}} ==Application== {{Quote|Should we arrest the Hutt, Senator?|Fox, to Padmé Amidala|audio=ShouldWeArrestTheHutt-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:CoruscantGuard-TCWfilm.png|thumb|right|250px|During the Clone Wars, clone shock troopers maintained order on the Galactic Republic capital as the Coruscant Guard.]] An elite division of the Grand Army of the Republic, the Coruscant shock troopers were trained to perform rapid strike missions. Additionally, they received special training for deployment in urban environments to serve as a security force in such locations. Their training gave them a high proficiency in close quarters combat, which, along with crowd control, they specialized in. A symbol of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine's executive power, they served primarily as security police for the Republic Senate, its buildings, and as prison guards tasked with keeping order in a large facility like the Central Detention Center.{{Databank|central-detention-center|Central Detention Center}} They also performed duties such as bodyguards for Republic officials and as urban [[Police officer|peacekeepers]] with some troopers trained specifically for riot control. Like the Senate Guard, which lost the authority to oversee high-value prisoner transfers after the betrayal of Captain Faro Argyus, shock troopers were sent as additional guards for prisoners during their transfer to Coruscant. Notably they escorted Ziro the Hutt and Maul. The Senate Guard had previously been tasked with the protection of Republic officials and buildings, but over the course of the war, it was supplemented & supplanted by the Coruscant Guard. [[File:Epguide519.png|thumb|left|250px|Clone shock troopers were trained in hunting high-value targets, including renegade clones and Jedi fugitives.]] Another aspect of the shock troopers' role was to capture or terminate high-value targets. This extended to hunting fugitives on Coruscant, such as Ahsoka Tano or Fives. Their [[commanding officer]], Commander Fox, was known for his sense of honor, his commitment to his duty as a soldier, and his loyalty to Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine. These traits were common among all clone troopers who served in the Coruscant Guard. Fox was regarded as an exemplary soldier, and his willingness to lead his shock troops in the most dangerous situations made him one of the most decorated troopers in the clone army.{{Databank|clone-commander-fox|Clone Commander Fox}} Commander Thorn and his men were likewise loyal to the Republic, and died fighting valiantly against its enemies.{{Databank|clone-commander-thorn|Clone Commander Thorn}} [[File:ClovisWithCISAndGARForces-TCWS06E07.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Clone shock troopers served as a diplomatic escort in addition to their main role as a security force on Coruscant.]] While the Coruscant Guard spent much of the Clone Wars away from the battlefield due to their assignment on the Republic capital, shock troopers such as Commander Stone possessed combat skills that were useful for diplomatic missions. For all of their training, however, neither Stone nor his troops were prepared for the experience of serving under Jar Jar Binks.{{Databank|clone-commander-stone|Clone Commander Stone}} The three shock troopers who served under Yoda on Rugosa were desperate to gain the Jedi General's approval, fearing that failure to complete their mission would invalidate their worth as soldiers.{{StoryCite|story=Sharing the Same Face|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} Lieutenant Thire was willing to sacrifice his life, as well as his shock troopers, by volunteering to remain behind to delay the Separatist droids for as long as they could. Yoda, on the other hand, was disturbed by the subservient nature of clone troopers upon feeling it within the shock troops. As such, he sought to educate the three about how they were individual people. The original purpose of the clone shock troopers was to serve as security police for the administrative buildings on Coruscant, as well as bodyguards for Republic officials. Following the establishment of the Galactic Empire, the shock troopers became elite units in the Empire's forces. Imperial shock troopers were high-class stormtroopers selected from the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. This new generation of shock troopers specialized in heavy weapons on the battlefield, forming elite frontline forces of the Empire. They also served as high-end security forces on Coruscant, as well as bodyguards for Emperor Palpatine. ==Equipment== ===Armor=== [[File:CloneShockTrooper-TSWB.png|thumb|left|200px|Clone shock trooper armor bore the red markings of the Coruscant Guard.]] Clone shock troopers were provided with the same [[clone trooper armor]] utilized by other clones in the Grand Army of the Republic. However, due to the shock troopers' role as specialized units in the Grand Army of the Republic, their clone armor and equipment were designed for "rapid strikes against high-value targets." A set of [[plastoid]] [[armor]] plates worn over a [[body glove]],{{Databank|clone-trooper-armor|Clone Trooper Armor}} the shock troopers' [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] had [[Color|red]] markings that distinguished them from other military units. Its successor, [[Phase II clone trooper armor]], was adopted by shock troopers after its introduction to the ranks of the Grand Army. With their new armor, the shock troopers adopted new unit markings associated with members of the Coruscant Guard. Like other suits of clone armor, they possessed a [[comlink]] on their right forearm, which was also equipped with the bodysuit's environmental controls. [[File:CG-Officer-P2-BF2.png|thumb|right|200px|Officers in the Coruscant Guard wore additional pieces of armor such as the pauldron]] Ranking shock troopers customized their armor with additional equipment, such as command [[pauldron]]s, [[helmet]] visors, and shoulder [[antenna]]s. The Phase II clone trooper armor continued to serve the Imperial clone shock troopers, who also retained the distinctive red markings of the Coruscant Guard, during the early years of the Imperial Era. Although shock troopers continued to use the Clone War-era armor well into the Galactic Civil War,''[[Star Wars: Commander]]'' in time a customized version of the [[stormtrooper armor]] was introduced to the shock troopers' ranks, bearing the familiar color patterns of the Coruscant Guard. The new armor bore distinctive red markings on the [[helmet]], spaulders, shin guards, and utility belts, which maintained extreme resistance to small-arms blaster fire. ===Weaponry and vehicles=== {{Quote|Jek. Concerned about weapons you are. Weapons do not win battles. Your mind, powerful it is! Mmm? Outthink the droids you can.|Yoda, to "Jek"|audio=YodaJek.flac|}} [[File:CoruscantGuardGunship.png|thumb|left|300px|A Coruscant Guard Gunship, the LAAT/i variant used by clone shock troopers.]] Shock troopers had access to weapons commonly used by soldiers of the Republic Military, including [[DC-15A blaster rifle]]s, DC-15A blaster carbines, and [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 hand blasters]]. These weapons had a stun setting that shock troopers used for the purpose of capturing or sedating their targets instead of killing them. However, under more dangerous circumstances they could be permitted to use lethal force. Having trained to maintain order among large groups of civilians or inmates, shock troopers possessed various [[melee weapon]]s and gear such as electrostaffs, [[TZ-97 "Zapper" Shock Baton]]s, and [[riot shield]]s. They were also provided with a supply of heavy weapons and equipment for diplomatic missions. These weapons included the [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]], the [[RPS-6 rocket launcher]], and [[grenade]]s. The Coruscant Guard Gunship{{LEGOCite|num=75354|name=Coruscant Guard Gunship}} was the name for a red model of LAAT/i used by shock troopers, whether or not they were on Coruscant itself. Often deployed in pairs, the stormtrooper variant served mainly as a support unit—taking vantage points, occasionally driving [[tank]]s, and suppressing enemies with the heavy arsenal at their disposal, which included a DC-15A blaster carbine, a DC-15A blaster rifle, a [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]], or an [[E-60R]] [[Missile launcher|rocket launcher]]. They also used the standard issue [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]], typical of every stormtrooper within the Empire. ==Behind the scenes== Clone shock troopers first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Shock troopers also appeared on the cover of [[Kanan 1|''Kanan'' 1]], although they do not appear in the issue itself.[[Kanan 1|''Kanan'' 1]] [[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'s card for clone shock troopers
